verification.scope: Five-PR integration, BIOL157 Units 3–9 and Cell completion batch
verification.summary: 230 offline and 40 real local Auth/Firestore checks pass with the 378-question Bio bank, no skips/failures. Lint/build pass with ten existing warnings and the large-entry warning. Chromium traverses 92 Bio lessons/599 sections and 46 Cell lessons/277 sections at 390px, twenty-one combined figures without clipped labels, Unit 5–9 exact feedback links, eight newer Cell citations and full banks (178/114/378), resume/retry/reload and three private progress panels. Eleven Bio PDF hashes/page counts and 406 literal anchors verified; 116 visual pages inspected. Previous Cell PDF/123-page evidence retained, not newly recertified here. No production test or formal academic sign-off.

deployment.status: Read-only inspection confirms existing Vite project prj_W0ZnmiQ9iO0oyeFPm4HAffXSiheO in the intended team and SSO protection enabled for all deployments. Six Firebase variables are shared across production and preview, with no RC-branch overrides; isolated preview Firebase is not established. No deployment or environment change performed.

blockers: No formal academic sign-off for the final student-visible content.
BIOL157 Unit 10 not authored; Units 1–9 have substantial source-checked teaching drafts pending academic review.

Cell: all 170 original rationales editorially improved and four review-only question revisions documented; remaining source figures, historical microscopy development, precise concept links, human approval and current-year official scope are unresolved.

Computer: exact manual acceptance steps are prepared but all 15 Microsoft Office desktop scenarios remain unexecuted; four questions withheld; payroll/grading/exactly-40/version ambiguities and 342 unmapped package pages remain open.
Protected preview requires verified existing Vercel project configuration and isolated test Firebase; production rules/auth domains/data separation/rollback not yet verified.
nextCheckpoint: Read all 48 actual Lecture 10 pages and implement five Lipids topics with independently checked linolenic-acid and ganglioside/sulfatide flags. Finish remaining Cell/Computer source and exact-concept gaps, human Office/academic decisions, auditable publication and isolated Firebase/Vercel preview readiness.
